audience: developers and on-call engineers who triage production errors in Sentry

useCases.title: Find the most frequent open issues
useCases.text: List the unresolved issues of an organization, sorted by frequency or trend. Open one issue to read its counts and first and last seen times.

useCases.title: Read the stack trace of an error
useCases.text: List the events of one issue and open one event. Read its stack trace, tags, contexts and breadcrumbs.

useCases.title: Compare error counts and durations in a table
useCases.text: Run an aggregate query, such as the count per issue or the p95 duration per transaction. Choose the errors, logs or spans dataset.

useCases.title: Review what each release changed
useCases.text: List the releases, newest first, with their commit counts and new issues. Open one release to read its totals.

useCases.title: Resolve or assign an issue
useCases.text: Change the status of an issue, its assignee or its bookmark. Only the fields you pass are changed.
